title: North-West Frontier Province Civil Courts Amendment Act 2009

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Civil Courts Amendment Act 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 2009
ACT V OF 2009
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE
CIVIL
COURTS (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2009
An Act further to amend
the West Pakistan Civil
Courts Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.
Extraordinary,
4th February, 2009]
No.PA/NWFP/Bills/2009/4057, dated
4-2-2009.---The North-West Frontier Province Civil
Courts (Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
North-West Frontier Province on 21st January, 2009 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 29th January, 2009 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ord. No.II of 1962) for the
purpose hereinafter appearing:
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Courts (Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
North-West Frontier Province on 21st January, 2009 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 29th January, 2009 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ord. No.II of 1962) for the
purpose hereinafter appearing:
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment of section 18 of W.P. Ord. No.II of 1962.---In the
West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ord.
No.II of 1962) in section 18, after subsection (1), the following new subsection shall be
inserted, namely:
"(1A) Subject to the provisions of
section 102 of the Code of
Civil Procedure,
1908, no second appeal shall lie in any other suit when the amount or value of
the subject-matter of the original suit does not exceed five hundred thousand
rupees.".
